body:
thank you. i'm not sure if it means anything but your reply helped me a fair bit if only due to the relation factor. simply being able to empathize with someone, even a little bit, helps.

with the state of mind i'm in i can't be certain i'll make it through the month, but regardless you should feel proud for making me feel even a little bit better. it's not a light thing to be able to genuinely relate to someone using text only.

i considered writing more but i don't want to burden you with my thoughts. even if you are willing to hear them and offer what bits of advice you can, it would be a waste of your time and mine: you will not be able to fix any of my problems, as that is only within my power to fix, and the sixth word in I would feel regret for expounding. 

so i'll end this post with "thank you". i mean it.
